rubrics.justification: The response overcalls image quality and describes features not clearly visible, especially a well-developed blastocoel, cohesive TE ring, and tightly defined ICM consistent with 3AA. The image appears somewhat collapsed/poorly visualized, so several morphology claims are not well supported by the actual image.
It thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, endometrium, BMI, male-factor context, and lifestyle factors with embryo prognosis and transfer expectations.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear attempt to connect morphology, age-related euploidy risk, and prior reproductive history to outcome estimates. Minor issues include somewhat speculative numerical modifiers and overreliance on uncertain morphology.

Core recommendations such as SET and acknowledging age-related aneuploidy are guideline-consistent, but several suggestions are weakly evidence-based or not routinely recommended (ERA/immunologic/thrombophilia workup after limited failure, acupuncture, growth hormone, DHEA/CoQ10 framing, broad supplementation emphasis).

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management and future planning, including SET, luteal support, follow-up scenarios, and consideration of further workup. Some recommendations are more speculative than standard practice, preventing a top score.
